decisions: Keep 25 mm and 40 mm radial arch-opening edits diagnostic: neither clears all sampled poses and they alter the reference body shape.
Keep front-only 1.5-degree alignment candidate outside production: joints are coherent with the experimental helper, but painted-body contact remains.
Do not promote experimental front carrier-rest correction until matched native support, unchanged-baseline regression and broader physical clearance are verified.
visual_observations: Matched views retain white paint, red wheels and gold caliper; the tilted front assembly has a subtle inward top edge.
The resting candidate does not demonstrate compressed or steered fit.
remaining: Front tire/fender swept clearance, neighboring suspension/hardware clearance and the full rear alignment remain unverified.
Candidate full re-export also removes legacy degenerate triangles; any later promotion needs a scoped preservation review.
Final Forza-level visual fidelity, frame rate and GitHub publication remain incomplete.
